label: D1 step while the agent leans moderately toward a1 (later in episode, not max value)
explanation: Fires only at D1 (never GO or D2), and only when the model policy logit already favours a1 moderately (choice in about 2.8..8; 98% of mass); it is nearly silent when the agent favours a2 (prev_action==2 or good==S2 carry under 3% of mass) and never fires in the first ~10 episode trials, with rate rising steadily toward the end of the episode. It prefers a rewarded D1 input (in_rew==1 gives 81% of mass) and lower-to-middle value (value >= 7.73 gives almost nothing). The recorded predicate uses only observed or model-internal quantities (phase, policy logit, value, episode trial) and captures ~98% of activation mass on dev, but precision is low (~0.29): many D1 steps in the a1-leaning regime stay silent. Adding in_rew==1 raises F1 to 0.52 but drops mass recall to 0.80. Magnitude is not captured well by the variables: in runs of consecutive rewarded a1 trials the activation often falls step by step (e.g. 1.00, 0.63, 0.30, 0.11), so it may signal a newly formed or still-strengthening a1 preference rather than a settled one. Upcoming action==1 (future) is a weaker predictor (F1 0.31) than the current policy logit.
